legend: It's well known that the best way to distract from something is to do one's favourite thing. Job is such a thing for Leha.

So the hacker began to work hard in order to get rid of boredom. It means that Leha began to hack computers all over the world. For such zeal boss gave the hacker a vacation of exactly x days. You know the majority of people prefer to go somewhere for a vacation, so Leha immediately went to the travel agency. There he found out that n vouchers left. i-th voucher is characterized by three integers li, ri, costi — day of departure from Vičkopolis, day of arriving back in Vičkopolis and cost of the voucher correspondingly. The duration of the i-th voucher is a value ri - li + 1.

At the same time Leha wants to split his own vocation into two parts. Besides he wants to spend as little money as possible. Formally Leha wants to choose exactly two vouchers i and j (i ≠ j) so that they don't intersect, sum of their durations is exactly x and their total cost is as minimal as possible. Two vouchers i and j don't intersect if only at least one of the following conditions is fulfilled: ri < lj or rj < li.
Help Leha to choose the necessary vouchers!
input: The first line contains two integers n and x (2 ≤ n, x ≤ 2·105) — the number of vouchers in the travel agency and the duration of Leha's vacation correspondingly.
Each of the next n lines contains three integers li, ri and costi (1 ≤ li ≤ ri ≤ 2·105, 1 ≤ costi ≤ 109) — description of the voucher.
output: Print a single integer — a minimal amount of money that Leha will spend, or print  - 1 if it's impossible to choose two disjoint vouchers with the total duration exactly x.
note: In the first sample Leha should choose first and third vouchers. Hereupon the total duration will be equal to (3 - 1 + 1) + (6 - 5 + 1) = 5 and the total cost will be 4 + 1 = 5.
In the second sample the duration of each voucher is 3 therefore it's impossible to choose two vouchers with the total duration equal to 2.

legend.ai: 众所周知，转移注意力的最好方法就是去做自己喜欢的事情。对于 Leha 来说，工作就是这样一件事。

于是，这名黑客开始努力工作，以摆脱无聊。这意味着 Leha 开始入侵世界各地的计算机。老板被他的热情打动，给了这名黑客整整 x 天的假期。你知道，大多数人更喜欢在假期去某个地方，因此 Leha 立即前往旅行社。在那里，他得知还剩下 n 张旅行券。第 i 张旅行券由三个整数 li、ri、costi 表示，分别代表从 Vičkopolis 出发的日期、返回 Vičkopolis 的日期以及旅行券的费用。第 i 张旅行券的持续时间为 ri - li + 1。
与此同时，Leha 想把自己的假期分成两部分。此外，他还想尽可能少花钱。形式化地说，Leha 想要恰好选择两张旅行券 i 和 j（i ≠ j），使它们不相交、持续时间之和恰好为 x，并且总费用尽可能小。当且仅当以下条件中至少一个成立时，旅行券 i 和 j 不相交：ri < lj 或 rj < li。
请帮助 Leha 选择所需的旅行券！

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 n 和 x（2 ≤ n，x ≤ 2·105），分别表示旅行社中的旅行券数量以及 Leha 的假期时长。
接下来的 n 行中，每行包含三个整数 li、ri 和 costi（1 ≤ li ≤ ri ≤ 2·105，1 ≤ costi ≤ 109），表示一张旅行券的相关信息。

output.ai: 输出一个整数——Leha 将要花费的最少金额；如果无法选择两个不相交的优惠券，使它们的总时长恰好为 x，则输出 -1。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，Leha 应选择第一张和第三张优惠券。此时总时长将等于 (3 - 1 + 1) + (6 - 5 + 1) = 5，总花费为 4 + 1 = 5。
在第二个样例中，每张优惠券的时长都是 3，因此不可能选择两张优惠券，使总时长等于 2。

titleZh.ai: C. 黑客，收拾好你的行李！
